caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object is a golden-yellow oil can, illustrated with realistic shading and detail. The oil can has a bell-shaped lower portion that flares outward at the base, a narrower neck, and a tall, thin spout emerging from the top center. Two symmetrical handles extend diagonally downward from near the top of the can to just above the base. The can is rendered in tones of yellow, gold, and brown to represent highlights and shadows, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. There are no other objects or background features, and in the lower right corner, there is a handwritten signature that reads "Herbert Taylor."
title: Whale Oil Lamp
